qe: If English alphabetical series is written in the reverse order then which letter will be 5th to the left of 4th from the right end?
qh: यदि अंग्रेजी वर्णमाला श्रृंखला को उल्टे क्रम (reverse order) में लिखा जाए, तो दाएँ छोर से चौथे अक्षर के बाएँ 5वाँ अक्षर कौन-सा होगा?
e:
Method 1 (Direction Reversal Shortcut Trick):
Step 1: Reverse series rule: Jab series reverse (Z to A) ho, toh prashn me diye gaye 'Left' ko 'Right' aur 'Right' ko 'Left' me badal dete hain:
- Given: 5th to the left of 4th from the right end.
- Converted: 5th to the right of 4th from the left end.
Step 2: Ab normal series ki tarah solve karein (Opposite directions = Addition):
$$\text{Position from Left} = 4 + 5 = 9$$
Step 3: Standard English alphabet me baayein (Left) se 9th letter 'I' hota hai.
Correct option  I hai.

Method 2 (Direct Visual Sequence Method):
- Reverse series: Z, Y, X, W, ..., C, B, A.
- Daayein (Right) end par 'A' hai. Daayein se 4th letter 'D' hoga.
- 'D' ke baayein (Left) 5 sthan aage badhne par: $4 + 5 = 9$th letter from Right end prapt hoga.
- Z to A series me right end se counting A se shuru hoti hai, isliye 9th letter 'I' hai.
Sahi uttar 'I' hai.

Exam point: shreni ke pattern ka niyam - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: If English alphabetical series is written in the reverse order then which letter will be 7th to the right of 17th from the right end?
qh: यदि अंग्रेजी वर्णमाला श्रृंखला को उल्टे क्रम में लिखा जाए, तो दाएँ छोर से 17वें अक्षर के दाएँ 7वाँ अक्षर कौन-सा होगा?
e:
Method 1 (Direction Reversal Shortcut Trick):
Step 1: Reverse series (Z to A) ke liye sabhi directions swap karein:
- Given: 7th to the right of 17th from the right end.
- Converted: 7th to the left of 17th from the left end.
Step 2: Same directions hone par ghataate (subtract) hain:
$$\text{Position from Left} = 17 - 7 = 10$$
Step 3: Standard series me baayein se 10वाँ letter 'J' hota hai.
Correct option  J hai.

Method 2 (Right-End Base Method):
- Series reverse hai (Z se A), arthath daayein (Right) end par A(1) sthit hai.
- Right se 17th ke Right me 7th: Same end hone ke karan $17 - 7 = 10$th from Right end.
- Daayein chhor se 10वाँ letter seedhe 'J' prapt hota hai.
Sahi uttar 'J' hai.

Exam point: shreni ke pattern ka niyam - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: If English alphabetical series is written in the reverse order then which letter is 6th to the right of 4th from the left end?
qh: यदि अंग्रेजी वर्णमाला श्रृंखला को उल्टे क्रम में लिखा जाए, तो बाएँ छोर से चौथे अक्षर के दाएँ छठा अक्षर कौन-सा होगा?
e:
Method 1 (Direction Swap + (27 - N) Shortcut Trick):
Step 1: Reverse series me directions swap karein:
- Given: 6th to the right of 4th from the left end.
- Converted: 6th to the left of 4th from the right end.
Step 2: Sthiti add karein (Left + Right):
$$\text{Position from Right} = 4 + 6 = 10$$
Step 3: Is sthiti ko baayein (Left) se nikalne ke liye 27 me se ghataayein:
$$\text{Position from Left} = 27 - 10 = 17$$
Step 4: Baayein se 17वाँ letter 'Q' hota hai.
Correct option  Q hai.

Method 2 (Direct Left-to-Right Countdown Method):
- Reverse series (Z, Y, X, ...) me baayein chhor par 'Z' hai.
- Baayein se 4th ke daayein 6th: $4 + 6 = 10$th letter from Left end (Z ki taraf se 10th letter).
- Z ki taraf se 10th letter = $27 - 10 = 17$th letter of alphabet, jo 'Q' hai.
Sahi uttar 'Q' hai.

Exam point: shreni ke pattern ka niyam - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.

qe: If English alphabetical series is written in the reverse order then which letter will be 2nd to the left of 5th to the right of 3rd from the left end?
qh: यदि अंग्रेजी वर्णमाला श्रृंखला को उल्टे क्रम में लिखा जाए, तो बाएँ छोर से तीसरे अक्षर के दाएँ 5वें अक्षर के बाएँ दूसरा अक्षर कौन-सा होगा?
e:
Method 1 (Direction Swap & Combined Calculation Trick):
Step 1: Reverse series ke liye sabhi directions convert karein:
- 3rd from left → 3rd from right
- 5th to the right → 5th to the left
- 2nd to the left → 2nd to the right
Step 2: Reference point 'Right end' se positions calculate karein:
$$\text{Position from Right} = 3 + 5 - 2 = 6$$
Step 3: Standard alphabetical position (Left end se) nikalein:
$$\text{Position from Left} = 27 - 6 = 21$$
Step 4: 21वाँ letter 'U' hota hai.
Correct option  U hai.

Method 2 (Relative Offset Method):
- Original reference: Left end (Z).
- Operations from Left end: $+3$ (start) $+5$ (right) $-2$ (left) $= 6$th letter from Left end (Z se shuru).
- Reverse series me shuruat se 6th letter = $27 - 6 = 21$st letter, jo 'U' hai.
Sahi uttar 'U' hai.

Exam point: shreni ke pattern ka niyam - ise yaad rakhein; isi tarah ke prashn pariksha mein doharaaye jaate hain.
